bull.narrative: Core Scientific reaches 1.5 GW Muskogee campus capacity and expands its cloud computing business aggressively, leading to significant revenue growth.

base.narrative: Core Scientific reaches 1.5 GW Muskogee campus capacity but faces moderate competition in the cloud computing market, leading to steady revenue growth.

bear.narrative: Core Scientific fails to reach 1.5 GW Muskogee campus capacity and struggles to compete in the cloud computing market, leading to stagnant revenue growth.

tracking_note: Strong unfair advantage in cloud computing, but dependence on a single customer (Microsoft) is a risk.
thesis_breaks_if: Failure to reach 1.5 GW Muskogee campus capacity within 2 years
